text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, HAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whew, feels real good out here! Gotta get
more used to runnin' on
the bumpy sand,
though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm doing just fine! In fact,
I feel like I
could keep running forever!
The ocean
works in mysterious ways, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and there's gonna be a festival
tonight. Gotta give my all in
training
before I get distracted by that. Up, up,
and away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our summer training camp is going well so
far. In addition to our daily
sessions, we've
been making a point to enjoy ourselves
when we can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've already indulged in some shaved ice
at the beach house, and have even built a
sand castle or two. Tonight's festival is
bound to be
another highlight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've worked up quite a sweat today! I'm
real tempted to go frolic
amongst the
waves, but that'll have to wait! Off for
another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our training is complete,
I return by
myself to the inn with time
to spare before
the festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not often that the lobby is this
empty.
No one should mind if I lie
down on the
sofa for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew, now that was a good splash! The
ocean here really is the
best! ♪ So nice
and cool...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's go back for round two— Ah,
wait! Gotta prep for the
festival. Off I go,
off I go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All righty,
done changing! Got everything I
need? Probably! All that's
left is to find...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mumu? Sleeping soundly? It's not bedtime
yet, so... a nap?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, today must've been really tiring I
guess?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Makes sense. We're out there training
every day, and we always
make time for
some hermit crab-hunting...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Could all of that have been a bit too
much?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Okay, it's on me now to provide a
recharge! Firstly...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(...What should I do first? How do I even
maintain my energy levels?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (Oh, that's right!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Twas a good day, good day! Today's a
great day! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm really lucky to have such
nice friends.

text_block_list.name: Active Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Machi! What you got planned for us
today? Cops and robbers?
Tag? I'm pretty
fast, so I'm good for anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's see then... How about some tag in
that case? Get ready! Rock,
paper,
scissors, pyoi!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Lady
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
dear! You can do it! I believe!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Street Man
text_block_list.text:
She's right!
There's no way you're losin' out
now after all those pulls.
You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You guys... Thank you! This one's for all
the marbles... Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Right.
It's thanks to all of my friends that I
can manage to be so cheerful. Now to
share some of it with Trainer in the same
way!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had only intended to take a nap, but
upon waking up, I can tell that
I was
sleeping for a good while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open my eyes to find heaps of food and
trinkets on the table in front
of me.
Roasted carrots, yakisoba bread, and even
novelty fans...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! G'morning!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wondering about this stuff? They're gifts
from everyone that are sure
to amp you
up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, you were fast asleep, yeah? It seems
you were really tuckered
out, so I was
hoping to find ways to give you an energy
boost.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I get all of my energy from others, so I
thought I could get some of
them to share
their energy with you too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Do you remember from before?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Turbo was nice enough to share those rare
crab gummies with me, and
Nature even
let me have the last scallop strip.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru even said some victory prayers
for me when we were eating the seaweed
jelly! The kids at the park and the
shopping
street folks...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You always say I've got lots of energy,
but I don't think I'd be that
way if I was alone.
Everyone's always so nice to me,
and that's where I
get my drive to keep on going.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted you to experience the same
thing! I hope it's gotten you
supercharged!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. I certainly have noticed just
how much everyone's
kindness keeps the
embers of her heart burning strong.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun, mumumu! Gather to me, spirits of vim
and vigor! Energetic,
energizing energy
blaaast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she hits me with her energy beam, I
take another look at the table.
There's no
rhyme or reason to how the items are laid
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can feel the warmth emanating from
each of them—the kindness
of many.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really? Feelin' pumped up again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, good! That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but hey, is all this stuff actually
enough? Anything else you want?
I should
be able to get anything pretty easily!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I let her know that I'm okay, she
traipses around for a bit naming off the
various things she thinks I'll like,
which is also invigorating in
its own way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wow, just look at this sea of people! The
shores ring with their voices!
This is one
happening festival, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is right at home within
the lively festival
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mambo, mambo! Do the festival mambo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh. It's a special festival cheer
that my dad taught me.
Wanna do it
together?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, mambo! Do the festival mambo!
Back and forth now, back
and forth, do
the festival mambo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She clearly receives as much love from her
family as she does from everyone else. And
I'm looking forward to the fun days ahead
being
part of her life too.
